ABOUT THE PRODUCT

Home and Kitchen Helpers.

This group contains products that serve various household needs alongside the cleaning routine: a drying sponge and dish mat for draining dishes, the Lekesil melamine sponge, which is used simply moistened with water, a refrigerator mat for fridge shelves, and a self-adhesive threshold sponge that seals the gap under a door.

Before using the Lekesil sponge on delicate or shiny surfaces, we recommend testing it on a small, inconspicuous area.

  • Dish drying sponge and mat
  • Lekesil melamine sponge
  • Refrigerator mat
  • Self-adhesive door threshold sponge
